_note: Baseline of app-local CSS component-class families (first hyphen segment of classes DEFINED in each app's own css). The frontend canon guard (#1421) fails when an app grows a NEW family: new UI belongs in the reference + @digithings/web first (cloudflare/digiweb/MIGRATION.md). To extend deliberately, add the prefix here in the same PR with a justifying comment in that PR's body.
_dq: dashboard .dq-slab is the BLEND v0.1 tonal slab (surface + hairline, radius 0) that replaced the retired .glass-card family. MotionLayer reveals .dq-slab.
_acct: dashboard .acct-* is the digiweb account family (login, signup, session, settings) born in cloudflare/digiweb/reference/app/account/account.css. dashboard consumes the same prefix rather than forking a local one (PR #3264).
_dboot: digithings-web .dboot-* is the @digithings/web digichat boot-loader family (cloudflare/digiweb/web/src/styles/digichat-boot-loader.css); the site shell overrides one dock rule for the wide composer (ChatEmbedShell); same precedent as .tl-*.
_digichat_2_0: digichat 2.0 assistant-ui product CSS: .aui-* (stock Thread chrome) and .dark-* (theme variants). Added with the 2.0.0 cut (#3629); not a new app-local family.
